mentions.name: Grandpa CAD
mentions.description: AI modeling tool for 3D printing that turns prompts into printable models. An agent searches, builds, and verifies the generated parts, and its capabilities have progressed from simple shapes (a cube with a hole through it) to practical items like a Raspberry Pi 4 case.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://grandpacad.com - AI modeling for 3D printing
Been at it for about year and a half.

Really exciting stuff is happening literally every month, because underlying models are getting better and better. When I started it was pretty basic: “make a cube with a hole through it”. Now it’s at the point “make a raspberry pi 4 case” and the agent searches, builds, verifies…

mentions.name: GrandpaCAD
mentions.description: AI-powered 3D modeling software focused on simplicity, designed so that anyone—even complete beginners like the author's grandpa—can create 3D models without struggling with traditional CAD tools. The project recently received European funding and is gaining traction.
mentions.problem: Traditional CAD tools are too difficult for beginners to learn; teaching the author's grandpa to 3D model failed until an AI-assisted approach was found.
mentions.audience: People with no CAD background who want to 3D model, like the author's grandpa
mentions.source_excerpt: GrandpaCAD - AI 3D modeling software focused on simplicity. Made it so even my grandpa could model.

mentions.name: GrandpaCAD
mentions.description: A chat-based AI 3D modelling tool that generates dimensionally accurate 3D models from conversational descriptions, letting people who struggle with complex CAD tools create simple models for 3D printing. The author's grandpa has already triggered more than 150 generations.
mentions.problem: The author's grandpa owns a 3D printer but struggles to use any complex modelling tools.
mentions.audience: 3D printer hobbyists who find complex modelling tools difficult, starting with the author's grandpa
mentions.source_excerpt: Dimensionally accurate AI 3D modelling. My grandpa has a 3D printer but struggles to use any complex tools. So I am working on this chat interface to allow him to do some simple models.
